technique_name: Compare and contrast the given two pieces of data.
description: Both pieces of data present the same temperature, however expressed in different units of measurement. Piece 1states the temperature as 82 degrees Fahrenheit, a unit of temperature measurement used mostly in the United States, while Piece 2 states the same temperature as 28 degrees Celsius, a unit used throughout the world. Fahrenheit is a temperature scale where 0 degrees is absolute zero and water freezes at 32 degrees and boils at 212 degrees. In Celsius, water freezes at 0 degrees and boils
example:
Piece 1: The temperature is 82 degrees Fahrenheit outside.
Piece 2: The temperature is 28 degrees Celsius outside.
